verdict.rationale: Base44 is an AI app builder with a managed backend and built-in database, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any region or data-residency selection. The built-in DB comment (base44-comm-2) describes where persistence lives architecturally, not a residency choice, and the eject/GitHub features are adjacent workarounds that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
